ja: 『機動戦士Gundam GQuuuuuuX』(ジークアクス)より、「GFreD」をHGで立体化！
■特徴的な機体フォルムを忠実に再現。
■頭部は差し替えで「非展開状態」と「展開状態」をそれぞれ再現可能。
■胴体、股関節など各部関節の可動によりダイナミックなアクションポーズが可能。
■バックパックはフレキシブルに可動し、様々な角度で表情がつけられる。
en: From "Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX " (Sieg Ax), " GFreD" is made into HG!
• Faithfully reproduces the characteristic aircraft form.
• The head can be replaced to reproduce both the "unexpanded state " and the " expanded state".
• Dynamic action poses are possible by movable joints such as the torso and hip joints.
• The backpack is flexible and can be viewed from various angles.
